insight: Iran's performance in the 2026 FIFA World Cup has shown a notable impact from hydration breaks, with the team gaining momentum in 4 out of 6 breaks, indicating a slight increase in their pace of play after the breaks. However, when Iran was pressing before a hydration break, they tended to lose momentum, with a decrease in their pace of play, and this happened in both instances where they were pressing. In contrast, when Iran was not pressing before a break, they were able to maintain or increase their momentum, with a more significant increase in their pace of play, suggesting that the breaks allowed them to regroup and refocus. Overall, the data suggests that hydration breaks have been beneficial for Iran, particularly when they are not exerting high pressure on their opponents, allowing them to recharge and come back stronger.
